description:
Tests the coordinator's frame limit on a deployed board. A file picked in the browser is read as text and sent on to hkp-node, which reports only how many characters arrived — the report is small, so the only large frame is the one going from the browser to the coordinator. Needs the hkp-node kept under the name "node". Start hkp-node with HKP_COORDINATOR_MAX_FRAME_BYTES=1000000, deploy, and send a small file, then a 2 MB one: the small one arrives, the large one is dropped and logged as frame-dropped. Make the two files with:

head -c 75000 /dev/urandom | base64 > ~/Downloads/small-100kb.txt
head -c 1500000 /dev/urandom | base64 > ~/Downloads/large-2mb.txt

items.placeholder: Send a small file first to see the path works, then the 2 MB one. When a value is dropped, the line below keeps its last time; the board log shows frame-dropped.
